evidence.title: Real live device path
evidence.evidence: The published console now supports zero-install physical paths through Phone Camera PPG, phone motion sensors and direct BLE where supported. Status remains pending_human until the team records a real physical session; code readiness is not accepted as evidence.

evidence.title: Mission Day 127 detect-evaluate-act narrative
evidence.evidence: P17 deterministic Mission Day 127 scenario plus P10-P15 runtime surfaces provide the scripted software path.

evidence.title: Data-quality case separated from medical event
evidence.evidence: P17 artifact/dropout scenario and P13 DATA QUALITY routing preserve missing/poor data without silent imputation.

evidence.title: Offline operation and later synchronization
evidence.evidence: P14 encrypted local queue plus P15 authenticated store-and-forward path are implemented and validated.

evidence.title: Ground/research synchronized history
evidence.evidence: P15 Ground & Research Console and governed backend boundary are implemented.

evidence.title: Visible lab/biomarker provenance
evidence.evidence: P7 laboratory ingestion preserves source, specimen, method and reference-context provenance.

evidence.title: Independent release-candidate reproduction
evidence.evidence: P19 code path is prepared; final evidence requires the release-candidate workflow or an independent machine with Docker + Supabase CLI to pass the clean reproduction gate.

evidence.title: Final challenge video
evidence.evidence: Storyboard and exact 3-minute narrative are repository-controlled; the final original video must be recorded, hosted publicly and linked before submission.

evidence.title: NASA/Space Apps resources and attribution
evidence.evidence: Repository citation and attribution registers identify the challenge and NASA resources without implying endorsement.

evidence.title: Known limitations visible
evidence.evidence: P18 validation and known-limitations records explicitly state that the prototype is not clinically validated and document hardware limitations.
